title: Prime Check
statement:
Write a function that takes a whole number `n` and tells whether it is prime. A prime is a whole number greater than 1 whose only divisors are 1 and itself, so 0 and 1 are not prime.

The input is one integer `n` with `0 <= n <= 1000000`. Print `true` when `n` is prime and `false` otherwise.

Input:

```text
7
```

Expected output:

```text
true
```
hints: Handle the numbers below 2 first. They are never prime.
Try dividing `n` by every number from 2 upward. If any of them divides evenly, `n` is not prime.
You can stop once the divisor squared is bigger than `n`.
